gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — Multi-Workspace UI Switching + Monitoring Shell (G24)
objective: Bring the G23 Workspace registry/session selection onto the current FastAPI + static HTML/CSS/JS UI as a small multi-workspace switching + monitoring shell. Workspace selector is sourced from the backend G23 registry (TIPA + shwtp). Selecting TIPA reuses the existing 6-sub-line ASSY UI/runtime (ui_page /assy-demo, session/structure monitor only). Selecting shwtp displays the accepted G21 5-scope slice (RAW-INTAKE -> T100 -> T106 -> T108 -> DIST-P108) with key flow/tank values. Switching never mutates the inactive workspace session; each workspace view shows at least workspace identity, run/session state, simulation time/step, scope/unit structure, key current values/status and a small live trace. Shared run controls act only on the selected workspace/session. Unknown workspace/session/action fails closed. SH-WTP assumed topology/fidelity is never presented as site truth. Reuses G23 WorkspaceRuntimeRegistry + G22 RuntimeSession. The UI is observer/controller only; the domain runtime remains the truth owner.
required_deliverables: ShwtpPlantSlice.monitor_rows() read-only observer rows in shwtp/expansion.py
stop_conditions: Selection requires a major UI/product decision or broad redesign

acceptance_criteria.description: Workspace selector sourced from backend registry (TIPA + shwtp deterministic)
Select TIPA returns TIPA view reusing 6-sub-line ASSY UI/runtime
Select shwtp displays accepted G21 5-scope slice RAW-INTAKE..DIST-P108
Switching does not mutate inactive workspace session
Each workspace view shows minimum monitor fields
Run control only affects selected workspace/session
SH-WTP assumed topology/fidelity not presented as site truth
Static workspace shell page exists and endpoints are served
G23 registry + G22 session semantics unchanged; TIPA ASSY + canonical baseline + full suite green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
